name: local-token-visualizer
description: Visualize and count LLM tokens offline using a local Hugging Face tokenizer.

localTokenizer.model.markdownDescription: Tokenizer to use: a built-in or downloadable id such as `o200k-harmony`, `gemma-4`, `deepseek-v4`, `qwen-3.8`, `kimi-k3`, `glm-5`, `muse-spark`, `grok-2`, `mimo-v2.6`, `minimax-m2`, `mistral-small-4`, `llama-4`, or any Hugging Face repository id like `Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B`. Use **Local Token Visualizer: Select Tokenizer** to choose from a menu instead of typing.

localTokenizer.modelPath.markdownDescription: Optional. Absolute path to a local tokenizer directory containing `tokenizer.json`. When set, it overrides `localTokenizer.model`. Leave empty to use the tokenizer chosen from the menu.

localTokenizer.enableHighlighting.description: Enable the looping rainbow token overlay in visible editor ranges.

localTokenizer.showSplitCharCount.description: Show a subscript number after characters that are split across several tokens (for example an emoji that takes 2 tokens). The red box stays; turn this off to hide just the number.

localTokenizer.smallFileThreshold.description: Files <= this character count skip the debounce delay and tokenize immediately.

commands.title: Local Token Visualizer: Use Local Tokenizer Folder

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run fetch-tokenizers && npm run bundle
scripts.test:vscode: npm run compile && npm run fetch-tokenizers && npm run bundle && node .vscode-test.mjs
